markdown: **Activate—Spiritual Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [revelation](/Traits.aspx?ID=686)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The light cast by the symbol becomes bright light for 10 minutes and shines through bodies to reveal hints of the spirits within. Creatures in the light receive a –1 status penalty to Deception and Stealth checks. You can Dismiss this activation.
